text:
Sam: HelixCorp update  procurement wants the Order Form executed by the US billing entity (Helix USA) but the MSA executed by Helix EU. They also said the POC should not be eligible for SLA credits. Any blockers?
Priya: Split signing is possible but we need to link docs. Suggest an explicit recital in both MSA + OF tying the documents together and referencing a common POC ID.
Leo: Technical: POC will run on Dedicated; we can tag all traffic with a poc_id and tenant_id. Need OF fields: billing_entity, poc_id, tenant_id. Also confirm whether keys are BYOK or Redwood-managed.
Mari: Procurement note: if OF is under US entity we need EIN and remittance address. If MSA is with EU entity, VAT and EU legal name required on the MSA. Also they asked about invoicing party and tax handling.
Jess: Draft recital idea: 
```
Recital: The Parties acknowledge that the Order Form (OF-HELIX-[ID]) is entered into pursuant to the Master Services Agreement between Helix EU and Redwood dated [date] (MSA Ref: HELIX-MSA-[ID]). For avoidance of doubt, billing and invoicing under this Order Form shall be by Helix USA as set forth on the Order Form.
```
Also propose POC exclusion clause: 
```
POC Exclusion: For the initial sixty (60) days following the Effective Date, usage strictly attributable to the Parties' agreed proof-of-concept (POC ID: [ID]) shall be excluded from SLA credit calculations and from remedies tied to uptime or performance. This exclusion shall terminate upon Go-Live or at the end of the 60-day period, whichever occurs first.
```
Sam: That looks good. Add a line that SLA credits are only for production endpoints so test/POC endpoints excluded.
Priya: Legal: we'll need to ensure the recital appears in both executed docs and cite the same reference IDs so DocuSign audit trail maps. Single envelope preferred but two envelopes acceptable if each document references the other.
security-bot: Reminder: If MSA is executed by EU entity, DPA + SCCs required. Confirm whether Helix EU insists on BYOK/HSM; if so, onboarding window is ~3-4 weeks.
Leo: If BYOK/HSM, infra needs key rotation schedule and audit access notes. Add that to the onboarding checklist.
finance-bot: Note: Invoicing rules: Redwood can invoice Helix USA for services under the OF, but the invoice must reference the MSA reference and PO number. VAT handling will follow the billing entity's local tax rules; provide VAT ID.
Mari: I'll collect Helix USA EIN, remittance address, Helix EU legal name and VAT. Also confirm signer names and titles.
Jess: I'll post a clean draft of the recital + POC exclusion in /legal/drafts and flag legal-review. ETA 3 hours.
Sam: Ok plan: Jess drafts, Mari collects billing/signature info, Leo updates OF template to include poc_id and billing_entity, Priya to confirm DocuSign flow preference with the customer (single envelope vs two). I'll update Helix procurement after Jess posts. :thumbsup:
